input: Sort and label all tax documents by category

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which tax year(s) and document types are included defines the full volume and boundary of the task.
Whether this covers one person, a couple, or a business changes the categories needed and the complexity of the sort.
Whether the documents are physical, digital, or both determines the tools and workflow required.
A deadline (e.g. filing date) sets urgency and affects how thorough vs. fast the sorting needs to be.
The preferred category structure (e.g. by income type, by form number, by institution) shapes how labels are created.
The intended storage system (physical folders, cloud folders, a specific app) determines the exact format of labels and output.
Knowing what 'done well' means — ready for a tax preparer, self-filing, or long-term archiving — sets the required level of detail.

gold.taskTitle: Sort and label all tax documents by category
gold.taskDescription: Organise existing tax documents into clearly labelled categories so they are easy to find and use.

questions.title: Which tax year(s) do these documents cover?
questions.description: Establishes the scope — one year's filing, multiple years, or ongoing — which determines the total volume of documents involved.

questions.title: Are these documents for a person, couple, or business?
questions.description: Identifies whose finances are involved, which drives the number and type of categories needed.

questions.title: Are the documents physical, digital, or both?
questions.description: Determines the tools, workflow, and physical vs. software steps required to sort and label everything.

questions.title: Is there a filing deadline driving when this must be done?
questions.description: Sets urgency and helps prioritise speed vs. thoroughness in the sorting process.

questions.title: How do you want the categories structured — by form type, income source, or another way?
questions.description: Defines the labelling logic so the categories match how the user naturally thinks about their documents.

questions.title: Where will the sorted documents be stored when finished?
questions.description: Determines the output format — physical folders, a folder structure on a drive, a specific app like Google Drive or Dropbox.

questions.title: Who will use these documents once sorted — you, or a tax preparer?
questions.description: Defines what 'done well' looks like, since a tax professional may need a different level of organisation than self-filing.
